profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: My interests lie in application development, namely in creating analytical and reporting applications to crunch large amounts of data into digestible, meaningful portions on which decisions can be made easily and quickly.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description: Lead of the Engineering Sales Priorities Team, responsible for building tools that provide transparency and metrics into the performance of our sales force to help them focus on the right things and pivot quickly when needed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
2019 - current: Work in Sales Performance and Metrics. Developed sales reporting applications.
2017 - 2019: Worked in User Analytics and Management Reporting and Analysis

positions.title: RPI Ballroom Competition Coordinator
positions.description: Organized RPI Dancesport Competition 2016 and 2017, getting officials and resources organized.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: Remade website to be responsive and pruned unnecessary pages.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Worked in EPIC (under Office), migrating probe reporting system to newer health-reporting system more broadly used within Microsoft.

positions.title: Membership Chair
positions.description: Organized UPE applications and Induction. Planned and arranged Student-Professor Dinner Fall 2015.

positions.title: Cisco Commerce Intern
positions.description:
Working in Unified Commerce Experience (UCE) to measure code performance.
Working on Internet of Everything Beverage Tracking System to track customer usage of a coffee shop.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Worked on in-depth part-rule library and numerous web crawlers, both within a framework and as individual scripts, in order to gather data for company backend.
Interned over Summer of 2013 (July - August) and 2014 (end of May to August).

positions.title: President of Software Engineering
positions.description:
Organized and managed Software Engineering department of the team.
Worked with other departments in order to recruit and train new members, as well as building and maintaining robots for FIRST Robotics Challenge and demos inside and outside of the community.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description:
Created personal website to act as a resume as well as to host a list of personally-arranged sheet music, blog, and photo gallery.
In the Summer of 2015, the website was redone to be responsive and look nicer.
